title: Audit the private DIAT corpus and exported evidence views
summary: Establish the private copied/exported corpus and measure the user's reported approximately 315-hour recurring-speaker opportunity. Produce immutable manifests and allowlisted experimental views without retriggering transcription, calling core services, or reading gold labels into model inputs.
in_scope: Existing package validation and source-copy audit
Separate private labels and upstream result custody
out_of_scope: Running the full corpus or buying inference automatically
Fetching or modifying core project data
Promoting upstream identities to labels or enrollments
Claiming the reported hours/person count is verified before inventory
implementation: Select existing copied meeting-package directories and validate them with the existing DIAT handoff interface; hash every source and retain package/producer/schema versions.

Inventory original recording duration separately from unique provenance-group duration, usable diarized speech, meeting/body count, observed tracks, claimed people, verified references and label availability; report overlap and missing artifacts.

Construct blind consistency and frozen-candidate views from explicit neutral field allowlists; withhold upstream result names, original label-bearing transcripts and independently held outcomes from model-visible files.
Keep occurrence, availability, import and identity-verification clocks separate and state when historical replay is impossible; preserve package-local IDs versus DIAT vector IDs.
Write private immutable corpus/view manifests and a synthetic public example; refuse overwrite and ensure all real artifacts remain under ignored data/meeting-matter/.

Begin inventory and blind-view preparation with existing DIAT handoff tools after the scaffold; later MAT-062 and MAT-063 enforce common evaluation compatibility, frozen cohorts and leakage qualification before comparative claims.

acceptance.criterion: The inventory distinguishes user-reported scale from measured unique/usable source coverage.
acceptance.verification: Run on a small copied sample with duplicate recordings and missing audio; check separate reported and verified fields and no fabricated total.

acceptance.criterion: Blind model inputs contain only allowlisted fields and no upstream identity/gold-label payloads.
acceptance.verification: Inject sentinel names into result files, original transcripts and reviewer labels; assert absence from built input bytes while audit artifacts remain retained privately.

acceptance.criterion: Original recording clocks, source hashes and package IDs survive view assembly.
acceptance.verification: Use a cropped recording beginning at a nonzero offset and a multi-meeting file; compare normalized intervals and reject mismatched hashes.

acceptance.criterion: The assembler performs no provider/core/database/enrollment write operation.
acceptance.verification: Run with those clients disabled and write-path/network instrumentation; only the declared private output is created.

tests: Re-encoded/aliased recordings in one provenance group
Package with unverified upstream accepted status
Missing word timing and audio fixture that is non-playable
315-hour/5–10-people claim retained as unverified planning metadata
risks: Completed exports may contain identity hints inside source transcript text.
Reported hours may double count aliases or include silence/unusable audio.

reuse.application: Reuse canonical package validation, IDs, original-clock spans and artifact hashing.
Consume already completed private packages without another transcript/identity pass.

sources: User clarification, 2026-10-08, active Matter build: DIAT owns meeting learning; roughly 315 hours/5–10 recurring people is user-reported; crawler owns jurisdiction knowledge; private exported-data experiments only.
Original repository inputs: matterbrainstormspec; matterjevmesh; jevinmatter (brainstorming, not implementation evidence).
